notes: Two branches («ح»): the names after the last «ح» (هشام، حجاج) are written once and belong to both, so they are the shared tail.
The last «أبيه» is the speaker of «قال قلت يا رسول الله»: the father of Hajjaj, not named in the text.
«قال النفيلي حجاج بن حجاج الأسلمي» adds a nisba to the same name, not a different transmitter: left out.
